title: Agenbite of inwit. Inwit’s agenbite.
html_source: Agenbite of Inwit – literally, the ‘again-biting of inner wit’, or the Remorse (Prick) of Conscience.

anchor.prefix:
ning. Agenbite. Save her. Agenbite. All against us. She will drown me with her, eyes and hair. Lank coils of seaweed hair around me, my heart, my soul. Salt green death.
